---
name: release-notes
description: Drafts release notes from merged pull requests. Use when a release is being cut, or when the user asks to check what went into a version.
---

# Release notes

1. List the pull requests merged since the last tag.
2. Group them under Added, Changed and Fixed, one line each, for example
   "Fixed: export no longer drops the last row".
3. Write the notes to `RELEASE_NOTES.md` at the repository root.
